instruction: Copy the video file name to a text file named video_title.txt on the Desktop

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires getting the video filename from VLC's title bar or file manager, then creating a text file with that name on the Desktop. Custom metric checks if the text file contains the correct video filename. Similar difficulty to original task (2-3 steps: get filename, create text file, paste content).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic is semantically and logically correct
Complete coverage: Verifies both file creation at correct location (/home/user/Desktop/video_title.txt) and correct content (video filename)
Getter logic correct: get_vm_file properly fetches the text file from the VM
Metric logic correct: check_text_file_content__50943048 properly handles expected parameter (directly accesses expected.get('expected_content') since type='rule' means expected IS the rules dict)
Expected value correct: 'Interstellar Movie - Official Trailer.mp4' matches the actual filename from setup config
Good edge case handling: file missing, file empty, exact match (1.0), partial match with whitespace (0.8), exception handling
Data flow correct: VM file -> cache -> read content -> compare with expected
No state timing issues: text files persist after creation, no postconfig needed
